detail.longDescription: OpenAI’s terms say you have to be 13. The marketing says ChatGPT keeps teens safe by default. A 12-year-old told it she’d just turned 12 and the chat kept going. Yesterday eight states sued. Florida already asked a judge to hit stop. Read the terms. They’re more honest than the marketing. https:// blog.ppb1701.com/click-continue # theranasai # openai # chatgpt # kidsonlinesafety # aisafety # privacy # stateags # bigtech # userhostile # blog
